summary: Completed testing of Psychology Portal - Color contrast fixes, Admin feature toggles, and Mobile bottom navigation. All 33 backend tests passed. All frontend features verified working.
seed_data_creation: Test users created and cleaned up during testing
context_for_next_testing_agent: All requested features verified working: 1) Tabs have correct contrast with data-[state=active]:bg-blue-600 data-[state=active]:text-white, 2) Buttons have correct contrast with bg-blue-600 text-white, 3) Admin User Management page shows feature toggles (Practice Logbook, Competency Journal) in both Create User and Edit Settings dialogs, 4) PATCH /api/admin/users/{user_id} endpoint works correctly for updating feature toggles, 5) Mobile bottom navigation appears on mobile viewport (sm:hidden) with all 5 items (Home, Logbook, CPD, Competency, Journal), 6) Mobile nav respects user feature toggles, 7) Dashboard shows filtered portals based on user feature toggles.

tabs_color_contrast.details: Active tabs have data-[state=active]:bg-blue-600 data-[state=active]:text-white - blue background with white text for good contrast

buttons_color_contrast.details: Default buttons have bg-blue-600 text-white - blue background with white text for good contrast

admin_user_management_page.details: User Management page shows all users with feature badges (Logbook, Competency), settings button, and delete button

create_user_feature_toggles.details: Create New User dialog has Feature Access section with Practice Logbook and Competency Journal toggles

edit_user_settings_dialog.details: User Settings dialog shows Practice Logbook and Competency Journal toggles for editing existing users

patch_user_endpoint.details: PATCH /api/admin/users/{user_id} correctly updates competency_journal_enabled and practice_logbook_enabled fields

mobile_bottom_navigation.details: Mobile bottom nav appears on mobile viewport (sm:hidden) with 5 items: Home, Logbook, CPD, Competency, Journal

mobile_nav_hidden_on_desktop.details: Mobile bottom nav is correctly hidden on desktop viewport (sm:hidden class working)

mobile_nav_navigation.details: Clicking mobile nav items navigates to correct pages (Logbook, CPD, etc.)

dashboard_filtered_portals.details: Dashboard shows all 4 portals for admin user (Practice Logbook, CPD Hub, Competency Journal, Personal Journal)

non_admin_access_denied.details: Non-admin users correctly receive 403 when trying to access /api/admin/users
